component.name: IconButton
component.description: Circular icon-only action button with the same visual hierarchy as Button: primary, secondary, and tertiary.

antiPatterns.scenario: Creating separate notification components for badge on/off
antiPatterns.reason: Badge is a boolean property of the same IconButton.
antiPatterns.alternative: Use IconButton with badge=true or badge=false.

accessibility.screenReader: Icon-only buttons require aria-label. Badge is decorative and should be announced in the label when needed.

aiHints.context: Use as an independent component. Header must compose IconButton instances.
